name: Yen Jen
bio: Yen Jen (嚴仁; Yan Ren; Southern Sung dynasty) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 玉楼春 (Yu lou chun)
poems.author: Yen Jen
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
春风只在园西畔。
荠菜花繁胡蝶乱。
冰池晴绿照还空，香径落红吹已断。
意长翻恨游丝短。
尽日相思罗带缓。
宝奁明月不欺人，明日归来君试看。
